title: Keeping track of client billings and invoices
description: Spot unbilled work and keep every invoice accounted for.

detail.heroDesc: Stop losing billable time in the gaps between matter work. Let AI draft the entry, then you approve it.

paragraphs: Billing slips because it happens in the gaps between matter work. You finish a call or an email, and recording the charge gets pushed to “later” — then later never comes.

AI tools close that gap. They watch the work you're already doing — your emails, documents and calendar — and draft a billable entry for you. You review it, adjust it if needed, and approve it. Nothing is billed without you.
You can also ask in plain English, like “what have I billed Smith & Co this month?” or “which matters haven't been invoiced since April?”, and get a summary instead of opening the ledger.
overview.callout: Your review stays in charge. These tools draft the entry, but a person approves every line before a client is billed.
whatItCanDo: Draft bill entries from your emails, calendar and documents.
Answer plain-English questions about what's billed and what's owing.
Flag matters with unbilled work before month-end.

howToUse.copy: The tool runs quietly in the background of your day. At the end of it, it hands you a list of suggested entries — you tick, edit or discard, and the approved ones move to your invoice.
howToUse.videoCaption: Watch how PointOne captures your day and drafts the entries for you to approve.

detail.toolsIntro: These work well together: one captures the time, one turns it into invoices, one keeps the ledger honest.

tools.name: PointOne
pointers: Captures time automatically from email, calendar and documents.

tools.name: Biller
pointers: Turns approved entries into invoices ready to send.
Tracks what each client owes and what's overdue.

tools.name: Ledgerline

Flags gaps between work done and work billed.
